secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack secret key (Paystack dashboard -> Settings -> API Keys & Webhooks). A test key (sk_test_...) is enough to exercise checkout in the sandbox. Without it /api/create-payment, /api/verify-payment, /api/download and the webhook stay disabled (they return a clear 'not configured' error).

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the admin panel at /admin. Leave unset to use the local development default 'wagwanspark-admin' from .env.base44-defaults.

secrets.name: EMAIL_SCRIPT_URL
secrets.description: Google Apps Script web-app URL (https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec) used to email download links after a verified purchase. Optional — only the purchase-email step needs it.

secrets.name: EMAIL_SHARED_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret that the Google Apps Script email endpoint checks against. Optional, used together with EMAIL_SCRIPT_URL.
